pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions on the flank and lower neck exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges due to focal blur. The patches represent a higher spatial area ratio compared to the interstitial spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph with three-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the visible mid-section, though continuity is visually interrupted by foreground branch occlusion.
